access.notes: Open-source plane-wave pseudopotential DFT code; any version compatible with PBE pseudopotentials may be used.

Standard norm-conserving or ultrasoft PBE pseudopotentials from the Quantum ESPRESSO library; e.g., O.pbe-n-kjpaw_psl.0.1.UPF, Ni.pbe-n-kjpaw_psl.0.1.UPF, Zn.pbe-n-kjpaw_psl.0.1.UPF. Equivalent PBE pseudopotentials are acceptable.
